scopes.description: Effective permissions derived from fixed role table; not writable.

Principal.description: Role, action scope and namespace/group object checks all apply.

PrincipalCreate.description: Internal SERVICE principals provisioned only by trusted installer; fixed role permissions, no custom scopes.

CredentialIssued.description: Only displayed on creation; never stored in idempotency response, audit or logs.

ResourceScopeCreate.description: INSTANCE created during bootstrap. PROJECT parent INSTANCE; GROUP parent PROJECT. Server checks authorized parent and duplicate sibling name.

ResourceScopePatch.description: Parent immutable. Archive only after active child scopes/gateway assignments and bindings resolved; conflict409.

ConfigurationUpdate.description: Validate configuration against SKU capability schema; reject unknown/unsupported fields.

RuleBundle.description: Content immutable; edit creates new ID. State lifecycle does not mutate manifest.

BundleActivation.description: One active bundle per namespace on data node. Group canary rollout belongs to Rule.match.groupIds inside a complete bundle; unaffected groups retain rules pointing to old parsers.

IngressBatch.description: Authenticated identity must match namespaceId/gatewayId. Decoded payload <=64KiB/event, <=256KiB/batch; encoded HTTP entity <=1MiB. Enforce cross-field limits before acceptance.

IngressAck.description: Every request event appears once. Only ACCEPTED/DUPLICATE release matching gateway payload. Custody ACK does not imply parsed or delivered.

EventSelector.description: Range [from,to); bounded range and rows. Snapshot event selection when creating job.

RetryRequest.description: Same ID/payload/target version; only retry schedule changes. No reparse or remap.

TaskResult.description: Per-task nonnegative sequence assigned when result is first persisted; same resultId retains sequence/content across retries. Old sequence may be acknowledged without regressing task projection.

CustomerAck.description: Durable inbox ACK transfers custody; later business processing belongs to customer. Match target/version/delivery exactly.

activationEtag.description: Opaque strong ETag, including quotes; copy unchanged to If-Match.

CommandParamsConfigure.description: Server-assigned desired revision. Firmware must persist and echo this revision after exact readback; do not derive it from expectedReportedRevision.

OutputMapping.description: Deterministic mapping within data only: rename selected top-level fields, optional numeric value*scale+offset, output targetUnit label, scalar constants, optional wrapper. Required missing or nonnumeric fields quarantine the event. Identity/revision fields cannot be mapped.

RawEventV10.description: capturedAt omitted if source has no observation timestamp; mark UNSYNCED/ESTIMATED as appropriate. Server receipt time never masquerades as capture time.

RawEventV11.description: capturedAt omitted if source has no observation timestamp; mark UNSYNCED/ESTIMATED as appropriate. Server receipt time never masquerades as capture time.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque cursor bound to filters, ordering and expiry.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Strong resource ETag; missing428/stale412. Wildcard not accepted.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Scoped namespace+principal+operation. Same canonical request returns original resource; different body409. Minimum design retention7days plus execution/retry window.

BearerAuth.description: Opaque service credential, hash stored; no JWT assumption.

GatewayToken.description: SKU-specific unique gateway credential over verified TLS; separate audience.
